problem: Given the sphere $(x+3)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}+(z-4)^{2}=9,$ what is the domain of $z=z(x,y)?$

choices.value: The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $\sqrt{3}$ centered at $(-3,4)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $3$ centered at $(3,-1)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $9$ centered at $(-3,-1)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $9$ centered at $(3,-1)$
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $3$ centered at $(-3,1)$
